# Nested callout QA

> Introductory text.
>
> > [!tip]- Inner tip
> > - First instruction
> > - Second instruction
> >
> > | Item | Status |
> > | --- | --- |
> > | Example | Ready |
>
> Outer conclusion.

> [!danger] <img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
